#Exorcism Agency Demo Overview
Welcome to the Exorcism Agency Demo! This limited version lets you explore the Hunted Village map solo. A perfect way to test the waters before diving into the full game! 

#High Learning Curve
Be honest, this is not a simple game and have high learning curve. If you wanna be a qualified agent. you must Join our Discord at https://discord.gg/XTQSvRyuNs!  It’s the best place to get inside tips and skill to acting as a professional agent. Don't hesitate, this is a must done action!!

#Your Mission Awaits
As a recruit at the Exorcism Agency, gather clues inside the haunted building and follow instructions for exorcism. Different ghosts require unique approaches. Collect 6 pieces of evidence and input them into your pad before exorcising. Patience is key! You’ll start with $1,500 to buy basic gear. As you improve, earn more cash for better equipment.

# Upgrade to the Full Version (Only$9.9 before Nov.1th!)
Once you gain experience, consider upgrading to the full version of Exorcism Agency. The official release features:
- 4-player multiplayer mode.
- 4 additional maps.
- A complete roster of ghost types and all the gear you’ll need.

We’re excited for you to dive into Exorcism Agency! Your supernatural adventure begins now, and with our Discord community, you’ll be ready to tackle any ghost that comes your way. Good luck, and see you in the game!
